scoring_justification: Full recompute of the DFT/NEB quantities is infeasible because the verifier sandbox cannot re-execute the heavy first-principles calculations. The checker compares the agent's reported JSON values to the paper's published gold with tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference gold values for the six quantities reported in the paper: band gaps, charge transfers, diffusion barrier.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper: band gaps from Fig. 3 (SQ-COP-1: 1.98 eV, SQ-COP-2: 2.14 eV, SQ-COP-3: 1.79 eV); charge transfers from Table 1 (Li26@SQ-COP-1: 3 e, Li26@SQ-COP-2: 1 e); diffusion barrier from Fig. 8 (DP2: 0.002 eV).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's stated numerical results.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's actual reported values, traceable to the paper's tables/figures.

outputs.description: Collection of reproduced quantities for numerical comparison with hidden paper-reported values.

output_contract.notes: All quantities are absolute values derived from the DFT/NEB calculations. The checker compares them to the paper's reported numbers within tolerances.
